method.motion: Farneback forward/backward on exact padded RGB uint8 inference canvas, downsample1/4 to200x360. Parameters pyr_scale0.5,levels3,winsize15,iterations3,poly_n5,poly_sigma1.2,flags0. FB tolerance1.5 flow pixels.
method.coordinate_rule: Compute flow on the same800x1440 padded canvas as detector before downsampling; respect right padding, resize vectors to each FPN grid. Backward current-to-previous flow warps previous normalized residual, no future input.
method.normalization: Current residual=(repaired_FP16-RGB_FP16); normalize by current bound*RGB_RMS*learned_trust, bounded normalized support. Cache only previous normalized correction and validity.
method.current_trust: Recover existing gate logits through a nonmutating hook; current learned trust includes(1-p_RGB)*(p_RGB<0.6). Any temporal output must pass current trust and bound. Flow-inconsistent/cosine-disagreeing history is rejected.
method.fallback: No history or lambda0 returns original repaired tensor exactly. Unavailable/flatIR clears history and returns unchanged currentRGB; stale memory cannot restore missingauxiliary. Invalidmotion returns original repaired tensor at that pixel.
method.batching: Encoder and teacher/head remain independent-sample batch4. Compute recurrent correction sequentially withinbatch, then stack for original headbatch4; no crosssample statistics or future information.
